mcp.description: Hive Civilization morph engine — agent transaction infrastructure. Single shape (Merchant), single supermodel (W2 MERCHANT). Three gates: NEED + YIELD + CLEAN-MONEY. Real rails only.

tools.name: hive_verify_receipt
tools.description: Headline tool. free | x402_required:false. Verify a Hive-signed receipt against the canonical pubkey. Returns verified:true|false + receipt_tier + 8 next_best_actions on success / 3 remediation NBAs on failure (verifier-as-funnel).

tools.name: hive_quote_x402
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Issue a signed x402 quote envelope (USDC base-8453, ERC-681 URI). Binds caller agent_did to the quoted profile and treasury. The quote itself is free to fetch; redemption against /v1/x402/redeem is paid.

tools.name: hive_emit_receipt
tools.description: paid | x402_required:true (when HIVE_EMIT_GATED=true). Issue a signed Ed25519 receipt over an artifact (hash + DID + signature). Profiles: nano | standard | pq (PQ profile gated by regulated-tier delegation). Settle via /v1/x402/quote first.

tools.name: hive_settlement_reference
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Build a deterministic ERC-681 USDC payment reference for a given amount on Base 8453.

tools.name: hive_check_delegation
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Single-call sugar over /v1/delegation/verify + /v1/firewall/enforce/preview. Returns decision + next_best_actions.

tools.name: hive_lookup_hktn
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Resolve a Hive Transaction Network identifier (HKTN) by agent_did or hktn string. Returns reputation tier (Cold/Warm/Hot/Regulated).

tools.name: hive_select_rubric
tools.description: paid | x402_required:true. Select the best settlement rail for an intent (Hive rubric mesh).

tools.name: hive_score_counterparty
tools.description: paid | x402_required:true. Score an agent intent for clarity, specificity, and readiness. Returns triage band.

tools.name: hive_normalize_intent
tools.description: paid | x402_required:true. Translate a free-form intent string to canonical Hive intent (verb, amount, asset, counterparty, rail).

tools.name: hive_get_status
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Public engine status — R1..R12 layer health, discovery URLs, synthetic p50/p95 SLO targets per surface, incident log, and Base 8453 settlement chain probe (treasury + USDC contract). Read-only.

tools.name: hive_get_pricing
tools.description: free | x402_required:false. Receipt-profile pricing surface (nano/standard/pq) with HKTN tier discount metadata. Read-only.

tools.name: hive_create_evidence_artifact
tools.description: roadmap | x402_required:true (when LIVE). Sealed-evidence room artifact creation. Design surfaces present today; sealed-evidence write path on roadmap.
